RESULTS May 11, 2026 CP Axtra CPAXT TB / CPAXT.BK Beat, but cost pressure ahead Sector: Commerce NEUTRAL Rating: HOLD Target Price: Bt17.00 Price (May 8, 2026): Bt14.70 Core profit beat our estimate and the street CPAXT reported a 1Q26 core profit of Bt2.79bn, up by 6% YoY and 9% QoQ, beating our estimate and the Bloomberg consensus. The beat was mainly due to gains of Bt240-250m tied to the reversal of a merchandise inventory impairment and FX hedging. The YoY growth was driven by two factors. First, the Aug 2025 consolidation of Renewed Hope Group (a Malaysian food service firm ) boosted wholesale b iz sales. Wholesale, which c omprised 52% of CPAXT’s 1Q26 EBIT, posted an operating profit of Bt2.52bn, up 6% YoY. Second, financ ial costs declined by 8% YoY, in line with lower interest rates. The QoQ improvement mainly reflected the easing of large merchandise inventory impairments at the retail b iz. Retail co mprised 48% of CPAXT’s 1Q26 EBIT. Note that CPAXT booked about Bt850m of merchandise inventory impairments to its 4Q25 financial statements. Result highlights Consolidated sales totaled Bt130.7bn in 1Q26 , up by 5% YoY and 2% QoQ. Growth was led by makro (57% of sales). Wholesale sales rose by 6% YoY, supported by the consolidation of Renewed Hope Group, two new stores, and 0.6% SSSG. Retail sales grew by 3% YoY, driven by store expansion, with s ales space up 4% YoY to 1.89m sq.m , retail SSS was flat, a clear improvement from a 7.6% decline in 4Q25, helped by FMCG panic-buying in Mar on concerns over price hike risk. Blended GM was 14.1%, down 40bps YoY but up 20bps QoQ, due to the easing of inventory provisions. Wholesale GM declined by 30bps YoY on clearance sales and a bigger proportion of slim-margin dry food in the sales mix. Retail GM slipped by 50bps YoY, squeezed by bigger inventory provisions in Thailand and a bigger proportion of slim-margin products in the sales mix, mainly dry food and alcoholic drinks. Outlook Looking to 2Q26, core earnings should decline both YoY and QoQ, squeezed by Happitat start-up expenses and a full-quarter hit from higher energy costs. Hilltop Offices, part of the Happitat real estate project , opened in Apr. We expect Happitat to book a Bt600m loss for 2026. What has changed? 1Q26 core profit comprises 27% of our 2026 core earnings forecast of Bt10.3bn (up 10% YoY ), close to the 1Q25 proportion of 2025 profit of 28%. อัตรากําไร และมี operating leverage ทีѷแข็งแกร่งกว่า CPALL ยังคงเป็นหุ้นเด่นอันดับหนึѷง
ของเรา รองลงมาคือ MOSHI และ CRC จากอุปสงค์ทีѷแข็งแกร่ง SSSG ทีѷปรับตัวดีขึѸน และ
แนวโน้มกําไรทีѷมีความชัดเจนสูง ขณะทีѷเรายังคงระมัดระวังต่อ CPAXT เนืѷองจาก SSSG ทีѷ
อ่อนแอ ค่าใช้จ่ายทีѷเพิѷมขึѸน และ operating leverage ทีѷเป็นลบ
